messages:
eva: Quick heads-up — planning a small docs sweep: TS snippet needs an RxJS example + AbortController, py needs async generator + sync wrapper, go needs context + io.ReadCloser pattern. I'll open tiny PRs.

tom: Split PRs please. I'll take TS and add a runtime type-check helper to catch doc drift.

lee: I'll handle Python. Plan: show `async for` generator and `stream_sync()` wrapper, plus a retry decorator with jitter. Will add a short Troubleshooting note about assembling partial token fragments.

eva: Tom, can you also add a tiny QuickTest.js that asserts the runtime chunk shape so docs and code don't diverge?

tom: Yep. Also adding a compat snippet to translate old `cursor` param to `resume_token` via a small helper. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5342 (WIP)

docs-bot: (docs-bot) PR 5342: link-check OK; lint: wrap long code lines.

priya: For Go I'll add context cancellation + an io.ReadCloser wrapper and a test that bounds cumulative sleep so CI stays fast. PR will be #5343.

eva: Nice. We'll also create a migration sandbox markdown that shows py/ts/go side-by-side and a tiny compatibility table (v0.9: cursor, v1.x: resume_token). Open that as a separate PR and tag docs-easy.

tom: PR #5342 opened. Included AbortController, RxJS buffer-time example, and the runtime type-check helper. Tagging @lee for editorial.

lee: Reviewing now. Small wording nit: avoid promising `resume_token` stability across incompatible model updates — link to model-versioning doc instead.

priya: PR #5343 opened with the test and tightened jitter after CI feedback. docs-bot: CI green.

docs-bot: (docs-bot) #5342 CI: warnings resolved. #5343 merged.

eva: Migration PR #5344 opened with sandbox and a compat util `compat.getResumeToken(params)`. Tagging `docs-urgent` for visibility.

tom: LGTM on #5344 after a small editorial tweak. Merging all. Good work — closing the thread. :tada:
